answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-work bridge between identity and value: to join the agent economy, each identity must lock a small refundable deposit and build a verifiable history of useful work, like an orchard that only bears fruit after seasons of care. A newcomer with no history can still enter, but only through slow, rate-limited channels, so one attacker cannot flood the lagoon of the marketplace with thousands of fake sellers at once. Creating one honest identity is cheap; creating ten thousand costs deposits, time, and compute, making large-scale sybil farming unprofitable.
